title: Control Loop
subtitle: The Engineering Under the Agent
description: An 8-part deep dive into the machinery beneath agentic systems: how control loops actually terminate, how context gets budgeted and compacted, how work fans out across subagents, how verification drives convergence, how code graphs get built and traversed, and how a production harness handles tools, permissions, sandboxes, traces, and cost. Written at mechanism altitude for engineers who already know why agents matter and now need to know how they are built.
author: Dana Okafor & Theo Lindqvist
